facts.fact: BCEAO Instruction No. 001-01-2024 of 23 January 2024 requires payment service providers in WAEMU to hold a licence after a transition that ended 1 May 2025, per Ecofin Agency.
The BCEAO licensed PayDunya and Bictorys as payment institutions, Mikaty and Flutterwave Senegal as payment service providers and InTouch as an e-money institution in Senegal.
